content: Seladelpar is indicated for the treatment of primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) in adult patients. It can be used in combination with ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) for those who have an inadequate response to UDCA or as monotherapy in patients who cannot tolerate UDCA. The recommended dose is 10 mg orally once daily. Baseline clinical and laboratory liver assessments should be obtained at the initiation of treatment, and regular monitoring should follow as part of routine patient management. The safety and efficacy of seladelpar have not been fully established. Drug Interactions: 1. Fexinidazole: This drug increases the levels or effects of seladelpar by reducing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or consider alternative therapy. 2. Gemfibrozil: This drug increases seladelpar levels by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 3.
